from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow metrics for one company from a single 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name from the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Report period in YYYY-MM format")
    operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities (positive = provided, negative = used)")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    investing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from investing activities (positive = provided, negative = used)")
    investing_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief excerpt from the cash flow statement for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyCashFlow]
